_note: Transport stacking matrix. maxStackPressureKpa is the internal vertical-crush limit on the item's top face: the box above is refused when (weight x g / contact area) exceeds it (horizontal forces and an item's own self-weight are out of scope for this model). canSupportWeightKg is a HARD ceiling on the total mass that may rest on the item's top face (candidate + everything already stacked on it), enforced alongside the pressure limit in placement-validator.ts. densityKgPerM3 is the weight-estimator fallback when the PDF carries no per-item weight; values lean conservative (over-estimate) so payload limits are never breached. orientationLock is the category-level default rotation policy (fixed|partial|none) — overridden per item once Material is classified (config/durability-rules.json, durability-tiers.json). 'pallet' is a separate ruleset (not a category) for a manifest's declared pallet lines: a pallet's stackability is a PACKAGING fact (a flat, structurally stackable transport unit), independent of what its description's matched category says about its contents — used in place of a category whenever that category would hard-veto stacking (canSupportWeightKg 0), e.g. a 'Pallet of Wine Glasses' description matching glass-panel.
